serverInfo.name: orva-store-mcp
serverInfo.title: ORVA Store Algeria Catalog & Delivery MCP Server

name: orva-store-mcp
description: Public read-only MCP server for ORVA Store Algeria (orva-store.com) providing product catalog pricing in DZD, 58-wilaya COD delivery fee lookups, and store contact/legal information.

tools.name: list_orva_products
tools.description: List published workshop tool packs and hardware kits from ORVA Store with current DZD pricing and URLs.

tools.name: get_wilaya_delivery_fees
tools.description: Look up home delivery (Domicile) and pickup desk (Stop Desk) shipping fees in DZD across all 58 Algerian wilayas.

tools.name: get_store_contact_info
tools.description: Retrieve ORVA Store business details, customer service telephone, email, WhatsApp, and legal page URLs.
